revisionDesc.change: Entered text from SB XXVI with the following changes: 1 Text of ed. pr. impossible on several counts, starting from line 0; something more agnostic is recommended, but this too is a stopgap. Ed. pr.'s Ἀρσιν̣(οιτῶν) is an impossible abbreviation, and if indeed the papyrus has πόλε̣(ως), we'd expect Ἀρσινοιτῶν written out in full. Another possibility is to read the name of the amphodon (= [πόλεως ἀπὸ ἀμφόδου] Ψ̣[α]ν̣πα̣λ̣λ(ίου) ), but it would be anomalous to have it with the description of the lessor in an Arsinoite text of this date; on the other hand, 9–10 imply an earlier reference to the amphodon, but this is normally part of the description of the lessee. (Point extensively discussed with S. Kovarik.) || 2 Αὐρ(ήλιος) → Αὐρήλιος; spacing suggests that the word was unabbreviated. || 24–5 We presented the docket in line with common pattern; image and original checked (the dots indicate real uncertainty). || 11, 14, 24 Incorporated corrections from Daniel, Architectural Orientation 61 nn. 93–94.
